en-US.description: Multi-user Music Box: each Echo is linked to its owner's own Music Box account and queue.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask music box multi to play blinding lights
Alexa, ask music box multi to link account
en-US.name: Music Box Multi
en-US.summary: Per-account YouTube Music control for Echo devices.
